title: MILO Marathon Urdaneta Leg 2026 Review: The Philippines' Series Heads to Pangasinan
seo_title: MILO Marathon Urdaneta Leg 2026 Review | Pangasinan Philippines
meta_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 Urdaneta Leg: November 8 in Urdaneta City, Pangasinan. 21K to 1K kids from RUNRIO — a qualifying leg of the Philippines' premier series.
dek: Set for 8 November 2026 in Urdaneta City, Pangasinan, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg offers distances from 1K to 21K. Registration isn't confirmed yet.
verdict: The MILO Marathon Urdaneta Leg is a provincial qualifying round of the Philippines' premier running series, produced by RUNRIO Inc. Five distances (1K, 3K, 5K, 10K, 21.1K) make it accessible across ages and abilities. Urdaneta City in Pangasinan — roughly 180km north of Manila — is an agricultural and transport hub in the Ilocos region. November is dry-season in Luzon, with comfortable morning conditions. Registration isn't confirmed yet, but for MILO series qualifiers, the RUNRIO production template is proven.

sections.heading: The MILO Series: Provincial Qualifier
paragraphs: The MILO Marathon series is the Philippines' most significant running circuit, with provincial legs feeding into the National Finals. [1] RUNRIO's production ensures professional timing, aid stations, and race-day logistics at every leg. Urdaneta City provides a provincial Luzon venue that's reachable from Manila by bus.
